title: A currency added in Settings cannot be used on records
label: BUG

panels.caption: Zoho: Create Deal right after Euro was added

rows: Save a record in a newly added currency
EUR added in Setup appears at once in the Deal Currency picklist (EGP, EUR); the deal saves in EUR.

EUR is active in Settings, but a deal in EUR is refused: "EUR is not one of the allowed values (EGP, USD, AED, JOD, KWD, OMR, SAR)". A deal in USD is refused the other way: "USD is not one of the organization's currencies".
Where the record Currency list comes from
The Currency field lists the active currencies from Setup.
Deals › Currency is a separate fixed pick list. A record currency must be in BOTH lists, and the two are not linked.
Filled from Settings (50) with a home-currency value (amount_home 50000), once the code passes both lists.
